text:
lina (procurement): Heads-up — vendor says EU allocation (50 H100s) is splitting. 30 units can ship immediately, 20 are held for an expedited air batch but with a +4% surcharge. They claim a customs HS mismatch triggered the hold. Need ops input and sign-off on split/credit note.
ashley (logistics): vendor contact? AWB? any inspection photos? :thinking_face:
matt (infra): what's the impact on our eu-west-1 pools if the 20 are late? rough numbers pls, diego.
diego (ops): losing 20 nodes for ~2wks knocks our EU Dedicated throughput ~18%. Batch jobs can failover to APAC but will hit higher latency/cost. Non-critical but affects backlog and SLOs.
vendor-bot: Shipment update: AWB EU123-456789 created; status: customs hold — HS code mismatch flagged. ETA for immediate 30: 2024-06-11. Expedited 20 (air) ETA if approved: 2024-06-03.
ashley (logistics): request vendor send inspection photos + commercial invoice correction. we also need explicit RMA terms: who pays return freight if units DOA or transit-damaged?
lina (procurement): vendor replied in thread: contact pierre@superchip.com. They say they will cover return freight for DOA but want a signed credit note for split shipment to clear customs faster. They also asked for pre-approved exchange manifest. Link to photos: https://files.superchip.com/ship-EU123 (sent by vendor).
matt (infra): operational ask: if they want us to sign manifest we must ensure serial-level acceptance and a depot QC step. no sign-off without us confirming kitting/serial list. Also propose SLA: replacement within 48h of arrival for any DOA; otherwise we bill standby/downtime.
ashley (logistics): +1 on serial list + depot check. holdback proposal: keep 5 units as spare pool in EU until reconciliation complete.
diego (ops): can we borrow from other regions for short term? yes but need network reconfig and will increase inter-region traffic costs. prefer vendor expedite.
pierre (superchip): confirm: we can release 30 immediately by sea, hold 20 for air at +4% premium. We will cover return freight for confirmed DOA and transit damage. We ask Redwood to sign a credit note for split shipping to correct commercial invoice. Photos attached and packing list provided.
lina (procurement): draft terms I want vendor to accept: 1) vendor covers return freight for DOA/transit damage; 2) vendor signs 48h replacement SLA post-arrival for DOA units; 3) vendor provides serial manifest before customs clearance; 4) vendor accepts holding 5 units as spares until reconciliation; 5) vendor corrects HS code to 8471.80 on commercial invoice. If they accept, we sign credit note limited to shipping split only.
matt (infra): add escalation: vendor ops contact + legal cc. also include a clause: if replacement SLA not met, vendor pays standby fee $500/unit/day until replacement or credit issued.
ashley (logistics): I'll open ticket INF-7834 to track the split shipment + RMA workflow and attach inspection checklist/manifest requirement.
diego (ops): decision: approve split if vendor signs the terms above. we cannot absorb the 2-week capacity hit without spares or a firm replacement SLA.
lina (procurement): I'll push back and request the vendor sign those terms and provide corrected paperwork. pinging @matt for SLA wording and @ashley to confirm holdback logistics.
pierre (superchip): ack — will confirm by EOD. provisional: can do 20 air at +4% if terms accepted.
ashley (logistics): noted. once vendor confirms, I'll schedule depot QC and customs clearing. :white_check_mark:
